content.user_title: Test Mobile Apps with Runtime Evidence
content.value_statement: Mobile app bugs and usability problems can remain hidden during routine checks. This skill guides exploratory testing with agent-device and captures runtime evidence for issues.
actual_capabilities: Check the installed agent-device version against the required minimum of 0.14.0.
Read current exploratory QA guidance through agent-device help dogfood.
Require a target app and infer its platform or ask for clarification.
Guide an app testing loop with interactive snapshots, screenshots, flow exploration, and app closure.
Capture evidence for issues observed during runtime testing.
Use current CLI guidance for report structure and evidence commands.
limitations: Requires a trusted agent-device installation at version 0.14.0 or newer, or approval for an exact-version npm command.
Requires an identified target app and access through agent-device.
Findings must come from runtime behavior, not source code inspection.
Detailed workflow and report formatting depend on installed CLI help rather than bundled instructions.

use_cases.title: Explore Release Candidate Flows
use_cases.description: Test key mobile app flows and collect runtime evidence for reproducible issues before release.

use_cases.title: Investigate Reported App Behavior
use_cases.description: Explore a reported problem in the target app and capture evidence when the behavior occurs.

use_cases.title: Review Mobile Usability
use_cases.description: Explore onboarding and navigation to identify usability problems visible during real interactions.

prompt_templates.title: Explore One App
prompt_templates.prompt: Explore [app name] on [platform] for visible bugs. Capture runtime evidence for each issue.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: a first exploratory mobile app session.

prompt_templates.title: Test a Specific Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Test [flow name] in [app name] on [platform]. Record observed problems and capture evidence without inspecting source code.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: focused review of a user journey.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Platform Behavior
prompt_templates.prompt: Explore [flow name] in [app name] on iOS and Android. Report observed differences with evidence from each available platform.
prompt_templates.scenario: Experienced: a comparison across accessible platforms.

prompt_templates.title: Run Scoped Release QA
prompt_templates.prompt: Test [app name] on [platform] across [approved flows] using test data. Follow current CLI reporting guidance and capture evidence for each issue.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: a scoped release review across several flows.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: explore onboarding in a mobile test app.
output_examples.output: Illustrative finding: the Continue button becomes hidden when the keyboard opens. Evidence: a screenshot and the interaction sequence that reproduced the issue.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: start exploratory QA when agent-device is unavailable.
output_examples.output: Testing paused because a trusted agent-device binary is unavailable. Provide a trusted installation or approve an exact-version npm command before testing.

best_practices: Identify the target app, platform, and authorized test scope before exploration.
Use a trusted CLI installation and consult its current dogfood help.
Use test accounts and review captured evidence for sensitive information before sharing.
anti_patterns: Do not install or execute the latest npm package autonomously.
Do not report source code assumptions as observed runtime defects.
Do not explore unrelated apps or capture personal data outside the approved scope.

faq.question: Which mobile platforms does this skill target?
faq.answer: The skill targets iOS and Android apps through agent-device.

faq.question: Which agent-device version is required?
faq.answer: Version 0.14.0 or newer is required because older versions lack the needed help topics.

faq.question: Does the skill automatically install agent-device?
faq.answer: No. It requires a trusted binary or approval for an exact-version npm command and prohibits autonomous latest-version installation.

faq.question: Does the skill inspect application source code?
faq.answer: No. Findings must come from runtime behavior rather than source reads.

faq.question: What evidence does the workflow capture?
faq.answer: The workflow uses interactive snapshots, screenshots, and issue evidence. Current CLI help supplies exact evidence commands.

faq.question: Where is the report format defined?
faq.answer: The installed CLI supplies the exact report shape through agent-device help dogfood.
